name: notify-relay Local P2P Notifications
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed local peer-to-peer notification relay with encrypted libp2p pub/sub, LAN discovery, Linux desktop notifications and optional ntfy forwarding; no published software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Build and operate your own Go binary on participating devices. Linux desktop notifications use D-Bus; WAN connectivity may require bootstrap peers or a self-provided VPS, and optional ntfy or network services have separate terms and costs. This is not a free hosted notification delivery plan.
